// CMS Content TypeScript Types
// Defines all types for managing website content through the CMS

export interface HomepageSection {
  id: string
  section_type: 'hero' | 'activities_around' | 'what_we_are_about' | 'testimonials' | 'cta'
  title?: string
  subtitle?: string
  description?: string
  content: Record<string, unknown>
  video_url?: string
  background_image?: string
  link_url?: string
  link_text?: string
  is_active: boolean
  order_index: number
  created_at: string
  updated_at: string
}

export interface PageContent {
  id: string
  page_slug: 'flow' | 'play' | 'surf' | 'the-spot' | 'privacy' | 'terms'
  section: 'hero' | 'intro' | 'faq' | 'features' | 'seo'
  title?: string
  content?: string
  video_url?: string
  image_url?: string
  json_content: Record<string, unknown>
  is_active: boolean
  order_index: number
  created_at: string
  updated_at: string
}

export interface PageSection {
  id: string
  page_slug: string
  section_type: 'hero' | 'intro' | 'features' | 'gallery' | 'pricing' | 'text' | 'image_text' | 'video' | 'custom' | 'local_break' | 'surf_lessons' | 'surf_conditions' | 'world_class_surfing'
  section_name: string
  content: Record<string, unknown>
  order_index: number
  is_active: boolean
  created_at: string
  updated_at: string
}

export interface PageData {
  slug: string
  title: string
  description: string
  sections: PageSection[]
  metadata: {
    seoTitle: string
    seoDescription: string
    featuredImage: string
    lastModified: string
  }
}

export interface Testimonial {
  id: string
  author_name: string
  rating: number
  text: string
  image_url?: string
  verified: boolean
  time_ago?: string
  is_active: boolean
  order_index: number
  created_at: string
  updated_at: string
}

export interface FAQItem {
  id: string
  page_slug: 'flow' | 'play' | 'surf' | 'the-spot' | 'general'
  category: string
  question: string
  answer: string
  order_index: number
  is_active: boolean
  created_at: string
  updated_at: string
}

export interface MediaItem {
  id: string
  filename: string
  original_name: string
  file_type: 'image' | 'video' | 'document'
  file_size?: number
  supabase_path: string
  public_url?: string
  alt_text?: string
  tags: string[]
  category: string
  is_active: boolean
  created_at: string
  updated_at: string
}

export interface CTAButton {
  id: string
  location: string
  text: string
  link: string
  style: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'outline'
  is_active: boolean
  order_index: number
  created_at: string
  updated_at: string
}

export interface ActivityLog {
  id: string
  table_name: string
  record_id: string
  action: 'create' | 'update' | 'delete'
  old_values?: Record<string, unknown>
  new_values?: Record<string, unknown>
  user_id?: string
  ip_address?: string
  created_at: string
}

// Form types for creating/updating content
export interface CreateHomepageSectionInput {
  section_type: HomepageSection['section_type']
  title?: string
  subtitle?: string
  description?: string
  content?: Record<string, unknown>
  video_url?: string
  background_image?: string
  link_url?: string
  link_text?: string
  is_active?: boolean
  order_index?: number
}

export interface UpdateHomepageSectionInput {
  title?: string
  subtitle?: string
  description?: string
  content?: Record<string, unknown>
  video_url?: string
  background_image?: string
  link_url?: string
  link_text?: string
  is_active?: boolean
  order_index?: number
}

export interface CreatePageContentInput {
  page_slug: PageContent['page_slug']
  section: PageContent['section']
  title?: string
  content?: string
  video_url?: string
  image_url?: string
  json_content?: Record<string, unknown>
  is_active?: boolean
  order_index?: number
}

export interface UpdatePageContentInput {
  title?: string
  content?: string
  video_url?: string
  image_url?: string
  json_content?: Record<string, unknown>
  is_active?: boolean
  order_index?: number
}

export interface CreateTestimonialInput {
  author_name: string
  rating: number
  text: string
  image_url?: string
  verified?: boolean
  time_ago?: string
  is_active?: boolean
  order_index?: number
}

export interface UpdateTestimonialInput {
  author_name?: string
  rating?: number
  text?: string
  image_url?: string
  verified?: boolean
  time_ago?: string
  is_active?: boolean
  order_index?: number
}

export interface CreateFAQItemInput {
  page_slug: FAQItem['page_slug']
  category?: string
  question: string
  answer: string
  order_index?: number
  is_active?: boolean
}

export interface UpdateFAQItemInput {
  page_slug?: FAQItem['page_slug']
  category?: string
  question?: string
  answer?: string
  order_index?: number
  is_active?: boolean
}

export interface CreateMediaItemInput {
  filename: string
  original_name: string
  file_type: MediaItem['file_type']
  file_size?: number
  supabase_path: string
  public_url?: string
  alt_text?: string
  tags?: string[]
  category?: string
  is_active?: boolean
}

export interface UpdateMediaItemInput {
  original_name?: string
  alt_text?: string
  tags?: string[]
  category?: string
  is_active?: boolean
}

export interface CreateCTAButtonInput {
  location: string
  text: string
  link: string
  style?: CTAButton['style']
  is_active?: boolean
  order_index?: number
}

export interface UpdateCTAButtonInput {
  location?: string
  text?: string
  link?: string
  style?: CTAButton['style']
  is_active?: boolean
  order_index?: number
}

// API Response types
export interface CMSApiResponse<T> {
  data: T
  message?: string
  error?: string
}

export interface CMSListResponse<T> {
  data: T[]
  count: number
  message?: string
  error?: string
}

// Content aggregation types
export interface HomepageContent {
  hero: HomepageSection
  activities_around: HomepageSection
  what_we_are_about: HomepageSection
  testimonials: HomepageSection
  cta: HomepageSection
  testimonials_list: Testimonial[]
}

export interface PageContentWithFAQ {
  hero: PageContent
  intro: PageContent
  faq: PageContent
  faq_items: FAQItem[]
}

// Validation schemas
export const homepageSectionValidation = {
  section_type: ['hero', 'activities_around', 'what_we_are_about', 'testimonials', 'cta'],
  title: { required: false, maxLength: 500 },
  subtitle: { required: false, maxLength: 500 },
  description: { required: false, maxLength: 2000 },
  video_url: { required: false, pattern: /^https?:\/\/.+/ },
  background_image: { required: false, pattern: /^\/.+/ },
  link_url: { required: false, pattern: /^\/.+/ },
  link_text: { required: false, maxLength: 200 },
  is_active: { required: false, type: 'boolean' },
  order_index: { required: false, type: 'number', min: 0 }
}

export const pageContentValidation = {
  page_slug: ['flow', 'play', 'surf', 'the-spot', 'privacy', 'terms'],
  section: ['hero', 'intro', 'faq', 'features', 'seo'],
  title: { required: false, maxLength: 500 },
  content: { required: false, maxLength: 5000 },
  video_url: { required: false, pattern: /^https?:\/\/.+/ },
  image_url: { required: false, pattern: /^\/.+/ },
  is_active: { required: false, type: 'boolean' },
  order_index: { required: false, type: 'number', min: 0 }
}

export const testimonialValidation = {
  author_name: { required: true, maxLength: 200 },
  rating: { required: true, type: 'number', min: 1, max: 5 },
  text: { required: true, maxLength: 1000 },
  image_url: { required: false, pattern: /^\/.+/ },
  verified: { required: false, type: 'boolean' },
  time_ago: { required: false, maxLength: 100 },
  is_active: { required: false, type: 'boolean' },
  order_index: { required: false, type: 'number', min: 0 }
}

export const faqItemValidation = {
  page_slug: ['flow', 'play', 'surf', 'the-spot', 'general'],
  category: { required: false, maxLength: 100 },
  question: { required: true, maxLength: 500 },
  answer: { required: true, maxLength: 2000 },
  is_active: { required: false, type: 'boolean' },
  order_index: { required: false, type: 'number', min: 0 }
}

export const mediaItemValidation = {
  filename: { required: true, maxLength: 255 },
  original_name: { required: true, maxLength: 255 },
  file_type: ['image', 'video', 'document'],
  file_size: { required: false, type: 'number', min: 0 },
  supabase_path: { required: true, maxLength: 500 },
  public_url: { required: false, maxLength: 500 },
  alt_text: { required: false, maxLength: 500 },
  category: { required: false, maxLength: 100 },
  is_active: { required: false, type: 'boolean' }
}

export const ctaButtonValidation = {
  location: { required: true, maxLength: 100 },
  text: { required: true, maxLength: 200 },
  link: { required: true, maxLength: 500 },

  is_active: { required: false, type: 'boolean' },

}

  code: string
  message: string
  details?: Record<string, any>
}

  VALIDATION_ERROR: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
  NOT_FOUND: 'NOT_FOUND',
  UNAUTHORIZED: 'UNAUTHORIZED',
  FORBIDDEN: 'FORBIDDEN',
  DATABASE_ERROR: 'DATABASE_ERROR',
  UPLOAD_ERROR: 'UPLOAD_ERROR',
  UNKNOWN_ERROR: 'UNKNOWN_ERROR'
} as const

export type CMSErrorCode = typeof CMSErrorCodes[keyof typeof CMSErrorCodes]

// Dashboard statistics types
export interface CMSStats {
  homepage_sections: number
  page_content: number
  testimonials: number
  faq_items: number
  media_items: number
  cta_buttons: number
  recent_activity: ActivityLog[]
}

// Search and filter types
export interface CMSSearchParams {
  search?: string
  category?: string
  is_active?: boolean
  page?: number
  limit?: number
  sort_by?: string
  sort_order?: 'asc' | 'desc'
}

export interface MediaSearchParams extends CMSSearchParams {
  file_type?: MediaItem['file_type']
  tags?: string[]
}

export interface FAQSearchParams extends CMSSearchParams {
  page_slug?: FAQItem['page_slug']
  category?: string
}

// Export types
export interface ExportOptions {
  format: 'json' | 'csv' | 'xlsx'
  include_inactive?: boolean
  date_range?: {
    start: string
    end: string
  }
}

export interface ContentExport {
  filename: string
  content: string | Buffer
  mime_type: string
}

// Email Service using Resend // Handles all email notifications for bookings, invoices, payments, and enrollments import { Resend } from 'resend' import { formatCurrency, formatDate } from './utils' import { env, isProduction } from './env' // Lazy initialization of Resend client to avoid build-time errors let resend: Resend | null = null function getResendClient(): Resend { if (!resend) { const apiKey = env.RESEND_API_KEY if (!apiKey && isProduction()) { throw new Error('RESEND_API_KEY is not configured') } resend = new Resend(apiKey || 'dummy-key-for-build') } return resend } // Email configuration - using validated environment variables const FROM_EMAIL = env.FROM_EMAIL const ADMIN_EMAIL = env.ADMIN_EMAIL const REPLY_TO_EMAIL = env.REPLY_TO_EMAIL export interface EmailOptions { to: string | string[] subject: string html: string text?: string replyTo?: string cc?: string[] bcc?: string[] } export interface BookingConfirmationData { bookingId: string guestName: string guestEmail: string checkIn: string checkOut: string roomName?: string surfCampName?: string totalAmount: number currency: string status: string bookingDetails?: any } export interface InvoiceData { invoiceNumber: string clientName: string clientEmail: string amount: number currency: string dueDate: string status: string bookingId?: string items?: Array<{ description: string; amount: number }> } export interface PaymentData { paymentId: string clientName: string clientEmail: string amount: number currency: string paymentMethod: string transactionId?: string bookingId?: string status: string } export interface EnrollmentData { enrollmentId: string participantName: string participantEmail: string surfCampName: string startDate: string endDate: string skillLevel?: string status: string } export interface RefundData { refundId: string clientName: string clientEmail: string refundAmount: number currency: string originalPaymentAmount: number reason?: string bookingId?: string } export interface PreTripEmailData { bookingId: string guestName: string guestEmail: string checkIn: string checkOut: string bookingType: 'room' | 'surfCamp' roomName?: string surfCampName?: string daysUntilTrip: number packingList?: string[] travelTips?: string[] affiliateLinks?: Array<{ title: string; url: string; description?: string }> location?: string weatherInfo?: string } export interface PostTripFeedbackData { bookingId: string guestName: string guestEmail: string checkIn: string checkOut: string bookingType: 'room' | 'surfCamp' roomName?: string surfCampName?: string feedbackFormUrl?: string reviewLinks?: Array<{ platform: string; url: string }> returnOffer?: { discount: number; validUntil: string } } class EmailService { /** * Send a generic email */ async sendEmail(options: EmailOptions): Promise<{ success: boolean; messageId?: string; error?: string }> { try { // Skip sending in development if RESEND_API_KEY is not set if (!process.env.RESEND_API_KEY && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') { console.log('📧 [DEV] Email would be sent:', { to: options.to, subject: options.subject, }) return { success: true, messageId: 'dev-mode' } } if (!process.env.RESEND_API_KEY) { throw new Error('RESEND_API_KEY is not configured') } const result = await getResendClient().emails.send({ from: FROM_EMAIL, to: Array.isArray(options.to) ? options.to : [options.to], subject: options.subject, html: options.html, text: options.text || this.htmlToText(options.html), replyTo: options.replyTo || REPLY_TO_EMAIL, cc: options.cc, bcc: options.bcc, }) if (result.error) { console.error('Resend API error:', result.error) return { success: false, error: result.error.message } } return { success: true, messageId: result.data?.id } } catch (error: any) { console.error('Error sending email:', error) return { success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to send email' } } } /** * Send booking confirmation email to guest */ async sendBookingConfirmation(data: BookingConfirmationData): Promise<{ success: boolean; messageId?: string; error?: string }> { const html = this.getBookingConfirmationTemplate(data) const subject = `Booking Confirmation - ${data.bookingId}` return this.sendEmail({ to: data.guestEmail, subject, html, replyTo: REPLY_TO_EMAIL, }) } /** * Send booking notification to admin */ async sendBookingNotificationToAdmin(data: BookingConfirmationData): Promise<{ success: boolean; messageId?: string; error?: string }> { const html = this.getAdminBookingNotificationTemplate(data) const subject = `New Booking: ${data.bookingId}` return this.sendEmail({ to: ADMIN_EMAIL, subject, html, replyTo: data.guestEmail, }) } /** * Send invoice email to client */ async sendInvoice(data: InvoiceData): Promise<{ success: boolean; messageId?: string; error?: string }> { const html = this.getInvoiceTemplate(data) const subject = `Invoice ${data.invoiceNumber} - Heiwa House` return this.sendEmail({ to: data.clientEmail, subject, html, replyTo: REPLY_TO_EMAIL, }) } /** * Send payment confirmation email */ async sendPaymentConfirmation(data: PaymentData): Promise<{ success: boolean; messageId?: string; error?: string }> { const html = this.getPaymentConfirmationTemplate(data) const subject = `Payment Confirmation - ${data.transactionId || data.paymentId}` return this.sendEmail({ to: data.clientEmail, subject, html, replyTo: REPLY_TO_EMAIL, }) } /** * Send enrollment confirmation email */ async sendEnrollmentConfirmation(data: EnrollmentData): Promise<{ success: boolean; messageId?: string; error?: string }> { const html = this.getEnrollmentConfirmationTemplate(data) const subject = `Surf Camp Enrollment Confirmation - ${data.surfCampName}` return this.sendEmail({ to: data.participantEmail, subject, html, replyTo: REPLY_TO_EMAIL, }) } /** * Send refund notification email */ async sendRefundNotification(data: RefundData): Promise<{ success: boolean; messageId?: string; error?: string }> { const html = this.getRefundNotificationTemplate(data) const subject = `Refund Processed - ${data.refundId}` return this.sendEmail({ to: data.clientEmail, subject, html, replyTo: REPLY_TO_EMAIL, }) } /** * Send pre-trip planning email */ async sendPreTripEmail(data: PreTripEmailData): Promise<{ success: boolean; messageId?: string; error?: string }> { const html = this.getPreTripEmailTemplate(data) const subject = `Your ${data.daysUntilTrip === 1 ? 'Trip Starts Tomorrow' : `Trip Starts in ${data.daysUntilTrip} Days`} - Heiwa House` return this.sendEmail({ to: data.guestEmail, subject, html, replyTo: REPLY_TO_EMAIL, }) } /** * Send post-trip feedback request email */ async sendPostTripFeedbackRequest(data: PostTripFeedbackData): Promise<{ success: boolean; messageId?: string; error?: string }> { const html = this.getPostTripFeedbackTemplate(data) const subject = `How was your stay at Heiwa House?` return this.sendEmail({ to: data.guestEmail, subject, html, replyTo: REPLY_TO_EMAIL, }) } /** * Convert HTML to plain text (simple implementation) */ private htmlToText(html: string): string { return html .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '') .replace(/ /g, ' ') .replace(/&/g, '&') .replace(/</g, '<') .replace(/>/g, '>') .replace(/"/g, '"') .trim() } // Formatting utilities are now imported from lib/utils.ts /** * Booking confirmation email template */ private getBookingConfirmationTemplate(data: BookingConfirmationData): string { const bookingType = data.surfCampName ? 'Surf Camp' : 'Room Booking' const bookingDetails = data.surfCampName || data.roomName || 'N/A' return ` Booking Confirmation

✅ Booking Confirmed!

We're excited to have you!

Hi ${data.guestName}! 👋

Thank you for choosing Heiwa House! We're thrilled to confirm your ${bookingType.toLowerCase()}.

Booking Reference: ${data.bookingId}

📋 Booking Details

Type: ${bookingType}
${data.surfCampName ? 'Surf Camp' : 'Room'}: ${bookingDetails}
Check-in: ${formatDate(data.checkIn)}
Check-out: ${formatDate(data.checkOut)}
Total Amount: ${formatCurrency(data.totalAmount, data.currency)}
Status: ${data.status}

💡 What's Next?

You'll receive a pre-trip email with packing lists, travel tips, and everything you need to know before your arrival!

Visit Our Website

If you have any questions or need to make changes to your booking, please contact us at ${REPLY_TO_EMAIL}

Heiwa House

We look forward to welcoming you! 🏄‍♂️
`.trim() } /** * Admin booking notification template */ private getAdminBookingNotificationTemplate(data: BookingConfirmationData): string { return ` New Booking Notification

New Booking Received

Booking ID: ${data.bookingId}

Guest: ${data.guestName} (${data.guestEmail})

Check-in: ${formatDate(data.checkIn)}

Check-out: ${formatDate(data.checkOut)}

Amount: ${formatCurrency(data.totalAmount, data.currency)}

Status: ${data.status}

Action Required: Please review and confirm this booking in the admin dashboard.

`.trim() } /** * Invoice email template */ private getInvoiceTemplate(data: InvoiceData): string { const itemsHtml = data.items?.map(item => ` ${item.description} ${formatCurrency(item.amount, data.currency)} `).join('') || '' return ` Invoice

Invoice

${data.invoiceNumber}

Dear ${data.clientName},

Please find attached your invoice for your booking with Heiwa House.

${itemsHtml}
Description Amount
Total ${formatCurrency(data.amount, data.currency)}

Due Date: ${formatDate(data.dueDate)}

Status: ${data.status}

${data.bookingId ? `

Booking ID: ${data.bookingId}

` : ''}

If you have any questions about this invoice, please contact us at ${REPLY_TO_EMAIL}.

`.trim() } /** * Payment confirmation email template */ private getPaymentConfirmationTemplate(data: PaymentData): string { return ` Payment Confirmation

💳 Payment Received

Thank you for your payment!

Hi ${data.clientName}! 👋

We have successfully received your payment. Your booking is now confirmed!

💰 Payment Details

${data.transactionId ? ` ` : ''} ${data.bookingId ? ` ` : ''}
Payment ID: ${data.paymentId}
Transaction ID: ${data.transactionId}
Payment Method: ${data.paymentMethod}
Amount Paid: ${formatCurrency(data.amount, data.currency)}
Status: ✅ ${data.status}
Booking ID: ${data.bookingId}

📧 Next Steps

You'll receive your booking confirmation and pre-trip planning emails shortly!

If you have any questions about this payment, please contact us at ${REPLY_TO_EMAIL}

Heiwa House

Thank you for choosing us! 🏄‍♂️
`.trim() } /** * Enrollment confirmation email template */ private getEnrollmentConfirmationTemplate(data: EnrollmentData): string { return ` Enrollment Confirmation

Surf Camp Enrollment

Confirmation

Dear ${data.participantName},

We're excited to confirm your enrollment in our surf camp!

Enrollment ID: ${data.enrollmentId}

Surf Camp: ${data.surfCampName}

Start Date: ${formatDate(data.startDate)}

End Date: ${formatDate(data.endDate)}

${data.skillLevel ? `

Skill Level: ${data.skillLevel}

` : ''}

Status: ${data.status}

We look forward to surfing with you! If you have any questions, please contact us at ${REPLY_TO_EMAIL}.

`.trim() } /** * Refund notification email template */ private getRefundNotificationTemplate(data: RefundData): string { return ` Refund Processed

Refund Processed

Dear ${data.clientName},

We have processed your refund request.

Refund ID: ${data.refundId}

Refund Amount: ${formatCurrency(data.refundAmount, data.currency)}

Original Payment: ${formatCurrency(data.originalPaymentAmount, data.currency)}

${data.reason ? `

Reason: ${data.reason}

` : ''} ${data.bookingId ? `

Booking ID: ${data.bookingId}

` : ''}

The refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5-10 business days.

If you have any questions, please contact us at ${REPLY_TO_EMAIL}.

`.trim() } /** * Pre-trip planning email template with packing list, tips, and affiliate links */ private getPreTripEmailTemplate(data: PreTripEmailData): string { const bookingName = data.surfCampName || data.roomName || 'Your Booking' const defaultPackingList = [ 'Swimsuit / Wetsuit', 'Surfboard (or rent from us)', 'Sunscreen (SPF 50+)', 'Beach towel', 'Comfortable clothing', 'Water bottle', 'Camera / GoPro', 'Travel adapter (if needed)' ] const packingItems = data.packingList || defaultPackingList const packingListHtml = packingItems.map(item => `
  • ${item}
    • `).join('') const defaultTravelTips = [ 'Arrive at least 30 minutes early for surf lessons', 'Stay hydrated - bring water to the beach', 'Check the surf forecast daily', 'Respect local surf etiquette', 'Protect yourself from the sun' ] const tips = data.travelTips || defaultTravelTips const tipsHtml = tips.map(tip => `

    ${tip}

    `).join('') const affiliateLinksHtml = data.affiliateLinks?.map(link => `

    ${link.title}

    ${link.description ? `

    ${link.description}

    ` : ''} Shop Now →

    * Affiliate link - we may earn a commission

    `).join('') || '' return ` Your Trip is Coming Soon!

    🌊 Your Adventure Awaits!

    ${data.daysUntilTrip === 1 ? 'Your trip starts tomorrow!' : `Only ${data.daysUntilTrip} days until your trip!`}

    Hi ${data.guestName}! 👋

    We're so excited to welcome you to ${bookingName}! Your check-in is on ${formatDate(data.checkIn)}.

    ${data.location ? `

    📍 Location: ${data.location}

    ` : ''} ${data.weatherInfo ? `

    🌤️ Weather Forecast

    ${data.weatherInfo}

    ` : ''}

    📦 Packing Checklist

      ${packingListHtml}

    💡 Travel Tips

    ${tipsHtml}
    ${data.affiliateLinks && data.affiliateLinks.length > 0 ? `

    🛍️ Recommended Gear

    We've curated some essential items to enhance your experience:

    ${affiliateLinksHtml}
    ` : ''}
    Visit Our Website

    If you have any questions before your arrival, don't hesitate to reach out to us at ${REPLY_TO_EMAIL}

    Heiwa House

    We can't wait to see you soon! 🏄‍♂️
    `.trim() } /** * Post-trip feedback request email template */ private getPostTripFeedbackTemplate(data: PostTripFeedbackData): string { const bookingName = data.surfCampName || data.roomName || 'your stay' const reviewLinksHtml = data.reviewLinks?.map(link => ` Review on ${link.platform} `).join('') || '' const returnOfferHtml = data.returnOffer ? `

    🎁 Special Return Offer

    We'd love to have you back! Get ${data.returnOffer.discount}% off your next booking.

    Valid until: ${formatDate(data.returnOffer.validUntil)}

    Book Your Return Trip
    ` : '' return ` How was your stay?

    Thank You! 🙏

    We hope you had an amazing time

    Hi ${data.guestName}! 👋

    We hope you had an incredible experience during ${bookingName} from ${formatDate(data.checkIn)} to ${formatDate(data.checkOut)}.

    Your feedback means the world to us and helps us improve the experience for future guests. Would you mind sharing your thoughts?

    ${data.feedbackFormUrl ? `
    Share Your Feedback
    ` : ''} ${data.reviewLinks && data.reviewLinks.length > 0 ? `

    ⭐ Leave Us a Review

    Help others discover Heiwa House by leaving a review:

    ${reviewLinksHtml}
    ` : ''} ${returnOfferHtml}

    Share Your Experience

    Tag us in your photos and stories!

    Instagram Facebook

    We'd love to welcome you back soon! If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out to us at ${REPLY_TO_EMAIL}

    Heiwa House

    Thank you for choosing us! 🏄‍♂️
    `.trim() } } // Export singleton instance export const emailService = new EmailService() export default emailService
